Name: Shebuel, Son of Gershom
Summary: Chief of the sons of Gershom son of Moses in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:16: Chief of the sons of Gershom son of Moses in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shebuel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
